units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 45:3">Targ. Ps. XLV, 3</cite>.—

<cite ref="Megillah 3b:10">Meg. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>מקרא מגילה ע׳</he> the reading of the M’gillah takes precedence; <he>מת מצוה ע׳</he> the burial of a dead person without relatives (v. <cite ref="M02284"><he>מִצְוָה</he></cite>) takes precedence.

<cite ref="Yevamot 39a:20">Yeb. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>חליצת גדול ע׳</he> the discharge of the Y’bamah (v. <cite ref="H01060"><he>חֲלִיצָה</he></cite>) by the elder brother is preferable; <he>ביאת קטון ע׳</he> the marriage of the Y’bamah to the younger brother is preferable; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲדִיפֵי</he>.
Meg. 3ᵃ אינהו ע׳ מיניה they (Haggai, Zechariah and Malachi) rank higher than he (Daniel); a. fr.–With personal pron. to be better &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 101b:10">B. Mets. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>לא עֲדִיפַת מינאי</he> thou hast no more rights than I have.
<cite ref="Ketubot 103b:3">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>לא עֲדִיפְנָא ממשה וכ׳</he> I am not more than Moses our teacher; a. fr.
